soqlQuery.value: SELECT Id, AssetId, OrderItemId, UsageResourceId, AccountId, EffectiveStartDateTime, EffectiveEndDateTime, ProductId, TransactionQuantity, EntitlementQuantity, UsageModelType, EntitlementUomId, EntitlementUomClassId FROM TransactionUsageEntitlement Where OrderItemId IN (SELECT Id FROM OrderItem WHERE OrderId = '{{sfOrder.Id}}')
